{{Top|leg}}
'''Ulan Bight''' was the deepest location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]], located in the southern portion of the [[Ul'Husk Ocean]]. It was over 1,300 meters deep.
